scope: Independent minimal Unix channel mechanism decision against AC-005 and audit2; no application edits or build claim
verdict: CONDITIONALLY RECOMMENDED mechanism refinement; not feature PASS
decision: Replace the plan-only socket-0600 mechanism with a current-UID canonical 0700 runtime directory, retained pathname/owner/inode checks, and enforced kernel peer-UID authentication in both directions before application bytes. Do not mutate process umask or chmod a socket pathname. Socket mode is diagnostic, not the portable authorization boundary.

plan_change_required.bounded_change: Revise only the Unix socket-mode mechanism and affected exact tests/proofs through the official plan review/progression protocol. Preserve directory owner/mode/inode and peer authentication obligations. No spec AC relaxation needed. A code-only change contradicting the reviewed 0600 plan is not authorized by this reviewer.

primary_sources.section: Pathname socket ownership and permissions; SO_PEERCRED
primary_sources.excerpt: Portable programs should not rely on this feature for security.
primary_sources.support: Linux honors pathname-directory permissions. Socket-file permission effects are not specified by POSIX, so portable authorization must not depend on socket mode. SO_PEERCRED supplies kernel credentials for a connected local stream.
primary_sources.inference: Directory restriction combined with mandatory peer authorization can replace the literal 0600 socket assertion without expanding the settings feature.

primary_sources.support: Darwin pathname connection enforces path traversal access.
primary_sources.limitation: Archived Apple manual, not runtime evidence for this current OS.

primary_sources.excerpt: Likewise, the client can verify the credentials of the server.
primary_sources.support: Darwin returns peer effective UID/GID established by connect/listen; both peers can authenticate their counterpart.
primary_sources.limitation: The API does not authenticate an executable identity or an entire session; expected UID must be checked before application I/O.

primary_sources.excerpt: If an access control entry exists on the file, it is evaluated and used to determine access rights.
primary_sources.support: macOS ACLs participate in access decisions before ordinary mode bits.
primary_sources.limitation: A metadata mode of 0700 alone must not be claimed as exhaustive directory-access proof. Mandatory kernel peer-UID checks remain the data-access boundary even when ACLs permit connection attempts.

required_contract: Use pathname AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM beneath the existing canonical, current-euid-owned directory; retain 0700, no alias and pinned directory identity validation before/after bind and before accept/connect.

Create the socket without process-global umask changes or pathname chmod; retain socket type, owner, device/inode and single-link checks. Do not claim or test literal socket0600 as the portable security guarantee.

Authenticate accepted client UID before handing a usable stream to request parsing or response rendering; caller convention alone is insufficient. Authenticate the connected server UID before the CLI sends any operation or reads any settings response. Failure/UID mismatch closes/refuses, with no application bytes or mutation.

getpeereid on Darwin and checked SO_PEERCRED on Linux must be kernel-sourced; never trust a UID/PID supplied inside the protocol. Same UID is the AC authorization identity; binary-signature/process-census security is not requested by this mechanism.

Directory/socket revalidation rejects identity changes and hostile aliases, without chmod or deleting a substitute. Same-user directory renames/replacements may cause fail-closed unavailability; no atomic race-free pathname assertion is claimed.

Retain failed or closed socket path instead of a racy stat-then-unlink cleanup; Step5 must implement reviewed lease-proven reclamation/lifecycle so normal restart does not stay permanently unavailable. The legacy singleton path is never removed.

audit_dispositions.process_umask_major: Valid actual concurrency issue: module mutex does not guard unrelated threads. Removing umask entirely removes the need to prove a single-thread bootstrap lifecycle.
audit_dispositions.failed_bind_cleanup_major: Retained path is a deliberate fail-closed result. Reject the proposed conditional stat/unlink guard as a race-free guarantee; another same-UID process can replace the pathname between check and unlink. Availability/reclamation remains an explicit Step5 obligation.
audit_dispositions.bootstrap_files: The socket-permission motivation for thread-count/entrypoint/bootstrap permit modules disappears with this refinement. No twelve-file bootstrap framework is required for AC-005. Root/worker must identify and roll back only their owned incomplete changes, preserving unrelated tested modules; this review neither deletes files nor certifies a rollback.
